newsitem.title: USA: U.S. WEEKLY MOLASSES REPORT - AUG 11.
newsitem.headline: U.S. WEEKLY MOLASSES REPORT - AUG 11.

text.p: Prices on sugarcane molasses were unchanged in the week ended August 9, USDA Market News said in their weekly National Molasses report. Molasses supplies are moderate and demand remains light. Domestic molasses usage is light to moderate.

According to USDA, molasses prices were supported by improving feedlot demand and continued good dairy demand in the upper midwest. Imports of Austrailian molasses and slow seasonal demand continue to pressure the molasses market.

1/ Per ton prices are based on 171 gallons for blackstrap molasses. To compute cents per gallon prices on cane molasses divide dollars per ton by 171 gallons ($ per ton divided by 171 gallons = cents per gallon). Ton - 2,000 lbs; Gallon= U.S. gallon.
**Prices represent sales fob terminal to the general feed trade in the respective areas but do not necessarily reflect sales to other trade areas.**
* Includes the major Uppper Mississippi river tributaries with the exception of the Missouri River.
Source: USDA-Illinois Dept of Ag Market News Springfield, Il. 217-782-4925.
